capabilities: Assign a random Lucide icon and color to every newly created note
Backfill existing notes that lack an icon via a command
Skip files that already have an icon
Toggle automatic assignment and restrict it to .md files in settings
extras: Installation is manual (download main.js and manifest.json from releases); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: it drives Iconize, assigning it a random icon and color per note the same way you would by hand
problem: Giving every note a distinct icon and color by hand through a picker is tedious, and Obsidian does nothing visual to distinguish new notes.

relations.evidence: a thin automation layer on top of it, not a replacement

summary: Auto-assigns a random Lucide icon and color to each new note by driving the Iconize plugin, plus a backfill command for existing notes.
